generator.interpretation: Synthetic probability that a realised Share traverses one declared eligible directed edge and becomes a realised recipient ExposureEvent.

prospective_exact_binomial_coverage.purpose: Analytical pre-run check that the chosen core opportunity counts can exceed the declared recovery gate under the idealized generator.
prospective_exact_binomial_coverage.interpretation: N=25 is retained as a non-gating stress condition because the idealized exact-binomial recovery probability can fall below 0.80; N=50 and N=100 are the prospective core conditions.

required_outputs: deterministic q=0 and q=1 control results
interpretation_boundary: This benchmark tests synthetic parameter recoverability and scheduler/transmission measurement integrity only.
q_transmit is not an estimate of human sharing, platform reach, ranking, attention, or real-world diffusion.
The estimator conditions on realised Share-edge opportunities and therefore does not jointly identify sharing propensity and transmission probability.
Delay values are controlled abstract-time design factors and are checked for realization accuracy; they are not empirically estimated.
Passing the benchmark can support RECOVERY_TESTED status only; it cannot establish EMPIRICALLY_CONSTRAINED or ACTIVE status.
